_comment: READ-ONLY pre-registration build input — the LEGAL SHAPE, with identity left to be filled in.
WHY the identity placeholders are not filled in here: `prereg build` requires
subject.baselineArmDigest / subject.candidateArmDigest, which are computed from
TWO REAL arm build closures. A static committed file therefore CANNOT be a legal
input: those digests do not exist as constants. Measured on this checkout:
=> exit 1, INVALID_FIELD: subject.candidateSourceSha must be a 40-hex git SHA
(HEAD + two arm dirs -> complete config). Generating a legal config from REAL
pinned checkouts is N1's scope and is NOT_PROVEN; see docs/evidence/E4-N7-report.md.
It is nevertheless worth committing because it pins the READ-ONLY property that
CAN be checked without a key: no inline catalog/selection (which `prereg build`
refuses — negative case a1 in the E2E), and a repo-relative root.
Commands (repo root, after `pnpm build`, NO provider key set):
Both must exit 0 and resolve NO provider factory call.
